item.title: DECEMBER ACTION AUCTION
item.description: Be sure to tune in to the KMMO Action Auction on Saturday, December 21 for a morning of great deals. You can save 40-50% off retail prices from local businesses. The event kicks off at 8 a.m. with JD and the KMMO Crew. You can even participate in bidding for some fantastic items. Keep checking back for updates on the list of items up until the Friday before the Auction. This month, we have several new items in store for you!
